audit.whatIsWrong: Five of the seven level-chart rows contradicted their own reasons. Level 1 was Skill while whys[0] says Jax wins the point-blank trade; Levels 2 and 3 were Jax while whys[1] and whys[2] say he concedes the poke and cannot pin Akshan; Levels 4-5 and 6 were Skill while whys[3] calls 4-5 Akshan's pure-laning peak and whys[4] calls 6 Jax's all-in window.
audit.why: The packet levelChart reads Jax / Akshan / Akshan / Akshan / Jax / Jax / Jax, which matches the written reasons exactly. The lane shape is a level-1 melee win, a poke lane from 2 to 5, then Jax takes over at 6.
audit.corrected: Level 1 Jax, Levels 2 through 5 Akshan, Level 6 onward Jax.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why and breakdown.late call Jax's ult 'Grandmaster’s Might', and the Level 6 row did not credit it as the spike that flips the lane.
audit.why: The content layer and the mirror audit both use Grandmaster at Arms, and it is the reason Comeuppance underdelivers — R's Armor and MR land the instant Jax commits.
audit.corrected: Grandmaster at Arms (R, 110s at rank 1) at Level 6 is the flip. Akshan's spikes are Heroic Swing at 3 and Comeuppance (100s at rank 1); Jax's are 6 and first item.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer's 'Counter Strike flips every AA exchange' boilerplate overstates E, and the wrong tool is named as matchup-defining.
audit.why: Counter Strike (17s at rank 1, 300 range) dodges attacks — his autos and the reload second shot — but Avengerang is an ability and lands through it. His real out-range tool is Heroic Swing (18s at rank 1, 800 range) versus Leap Strike's 700.
audit.corrected: E eats his autos and reload shots; Avengerang goes through. Leap Strike at 700 cannot reach a max-range Avengerang, so close on a minion or ward first.

audit.whatIsWrong: The two flagged suspectNames are false positives, and one _missing rule is wrong.
audit.why: 'Heroic Swings' and 'Use Heroic Swing' are the real name conjugated. The mirror audit records that the _missing entry claiming Going Rogue or Heroic Swing shuts off Jax's dashes misfired — Akshan has no grounding anywhere in his kit.

edits.before: Auto-trade only with E held in your pocket. Identify how Akshan contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: You out-trade him point-blank before Dirty Fighting stacks its shield — punish any step into last-hit range, no E needed.

edits.before: Counter Strike flips every AA exchange he starts. Only take the trade when Akshan's Heroic Swing is down.
edits.after: His reload second shot and Avengerang chip you for free before Counter Strike exists — farm and concede the poke.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Akshan must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Heroic Swing (18s) plus Avengerang pokes at a range Leap Strike (700) can't close — you cannot pin him for the stun.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Heroic Swing's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: His pure-laning peak: he kites your Leap Strike and pokes from outside Counter Strike's 300 range — don't force an all-in.

edits.before: Grandmaster’s Might stats win every extended duel from here on. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Akshan's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Grandmaster at Arms floods you with Armor and MR, so Comeuppance's stored burst pays out far less than it threatens. All-in now.

edits.before: Trinity Force is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Heroic Swing's cooldown.
edits.after: Trinity Force plus R's resists eat his lethality burst — force the fight the moment it completes.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Akshan carry threat 7.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on: Counter Strike eats his autos and reload shots, and Leap Strike into Empower into the stun closes the kill.

edits.before: Grandmaster’s Might stats win every extended duel from here on — build your teamfight around that. Akshan carry threat: 7.5/10 — shift to picks and wave control if he gets ahead.

edits.after: Hold E for his autos and reload shots, recast the stun, then Leap Strike in with Empower loaded and out-stat him.
